name: application-delivery-slot-picker
title: Delivery Slot Picker
description: Selectable delivery-window radio cards with description, price, and optional Free/Fastest badges, driven by a typed slots prop contract.
useWhen: Checkout flows where users pick a delivery window that affects price (standard vs. priority).
Some windows should carry a callout badge (Free, Fastest) to guide the choice.
A window may be fully booked and should remain visible but unselectable.
avoidWhen: You need a grid of many time slots across several days — use the Availability Grid instead.
Delivery has no time-window concept, only a single estimated date — a simple text line is enough.
Pricing doesn't vary by window — a plain radio group without per-row prices is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Each slot is a full-width card stacked vertically; the layout scales naturally to any container width without needing separate breakpoints.
accessibility: Each option is a real radio input inside a <label>, giving native keyboard and screen-reader support without custom ARIA roles.
The selected slot uses a thicker border plus a tinted background, not border color alone, to remain distinguishable.
Disabled (fully booked) slots use the native disabled attribute and reduced opacity together, and their unavailability is also stated in visible text ('Fully booked').

variants.title: Delivery Slot Picker
variants.description: Stacked radio-card list of delivery windows with price, description, optional Free/Fastest badges, and a disabled fully-booked example.
accessibility: The Free/Fastest badges pair a tinted background with a text label, never color alone.

variants.title: Delivery Slot Picker (Dark)
variants.description: Delivery-window picker adapted for dark surfaces with the same radio-card, badge, and disabled-state structure.
accessibility: Card borders, badge colors, and price text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
